title: Dimensional weight
description: Dimensional (volumetric) billed weight for a PARCEL — a DERIVED value the checkout computes, not seller-authored: billed = max(actual gross mass, volumetric weight), where volumetric = packaged volume ÷ a divisor, with each packaged dimension rounded up before multiplying, and the divisor read from the seller's shipping profile. Elective and NEVER default-on: composed only when a parcel is billed by dimensional weight. Carries the computed billed weight plus the divisor applied, so a reader reproduces the calculation from the packaged dimensions on the same order's figaro-cargo leaf. PARCELS ONLY — transporting people (ride-hailing) is a different, per-mile future clause; dimensional weight is not its concern.

fields.name: billedMassGrams
fields.description: The billed dimensional weight in whole grams — max(actual gross mass, volumetric weight), the greater of the physical and volumetric mass, per carrier practice.

fields.name: divisor
fields.description: The dimensional divisor applied (the seller's shipping convention, e.g. ~5000 metric). Committed so the billed weight is reproducible: volumetric = packaged volume ÷ divisor.
